provider_receipt.summary: Cannot approve the joined result: both dependency close receipts contain only generic closure statements and expose neither the approved leaf objectives nor substantive execution/verification evidence. The parent verify receipt establishes clean-tree status and lineage for this project leaf, but does not demonstrate that either dependency satisfied the full joined objective. Independent source review also found security/privacy defects: src/lib.rs accepts wikilinks containing parent-directory components and can report existing paths outside the vault, while scan_vault processes every Markdown file without enforcing the documented privacy, authority, status, quarantine, or review-required boundaries. Completion is therefore unsupported and the implementation conflicts with its ingestion contract.
